entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF551-98B.
Okay, I can definitely help with that. Let me just pull up that order, one moment... VF551-98B. I see the order for the Velo-Carbon cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Yes. I just need the return label.
Certainly. And just for our records, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They just don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but they keep giving me blisters on long rides. I just want a refund.

I'm sorry to hear that. Discomfort on a ride is the last thing we want for our customers. Let me just verify the return eligibility here... Okay, I see the delivery date was 73 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items.

Yes, we are. I've just approved the return on my end. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Simply pack up the cycling shoes, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, I see the email. Perfect. That's all I needed.
Glad I could get that sorted out for you quickly. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
